svg.title: TASK-061 perfect guard success rate vs RTT (synthetic Monte Carlo model)
svg.desc: Discrete-event Monte Carlo model, seed 20261017, 10,000 trials per point. Light attack startup 8f + active 3f at 60 fps; hit judged at 30 or 60 Hz server tick; guard edge sent with 60 Hz client sampling, redundant input copies (buffer 2), jitter 10 ms, loss 2 %; interpolation/snapshot delay 33 ms; human timing error sigma 25 ms; defense-interaction lag-compensation cap 200 ms; defender-favoring ON (client-timestamp reconstruction + retroactive guard evaluation + 1 tick window grace). Synthetic model, not a Unity/Fusion measurement and not a player study.

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: TASK-061 · 完美格挡成功率 vs RTT（Monte Carlo 模型，非引擎实测）

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: 窗口 100/150ms（以真实命中为中心）· tick 30/60Hz · cap 200ms · defender-favoring ON · 输入缓冲 2 帧 · 抖动 10ms · 丢包 2% · 插值 33ms · 人类时序 sigma=25ms · 每点 1 万次
